title: Unbounded derived exchange morphism
statement:
Let $\square=(f,f',g,g',\alpha)$ be a cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $f:X\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $g:Y'\to Y$, $g':X'\to X$ and $fg'=gf'$. Fix a commutative ring $\Lambda$ and use the module derived categories $D(T_{\Et},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. For each edge $u:U\to V$, the inverse image $u^{-1}$ of constant-coefficient module sheaves is exact and left adjoint to $u_*$ [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. On the unbounded derived categories let $u^{-1}$ be its termwise derived functor [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-functor], and let $Ru_*K=Q(u_*I)$ for a K-injective resolution $K\xrightarrow{\sim}QI$ [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions], [prop-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions-exist], [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-total-derived]. These give the canonical derived adjunction $u^{-1}\dashv Ru_*$ [lem-pc-derived-adjoint-functors], with unit $\eta_u$ and counit $\varepsilon_u$.

Let $\theta^D_{\square,\Lambda}:f'^{-1}g^{-1}\xrightarrow{\sim}g'^{-1}f^{-1}$ be the square isomorphism on these module derived categories: apply the canonical sheaf inverse-image composition isomorphism $\theta_\square$ termwise, using the module structures of [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], and descend along localization $Q$ [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property], clause (2), with the comparison isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-functor]. Naturality makes the termwise components commute with differentials; exactness makes the termwise composites preserve quasi-isomorphisms. For $\Lambda=\mathbf Z$ this is the unbounded square isomorphism of [def-weil-pbc-derived-square-iso].

For $K\in D(X_{\Et},\Lambda)$ the *unbounded derived exchange morphism* is the mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate]
$$
\Ex_{\square,K}:g^{-1}Rf_*K\longrightarrow Rf'_*g'^{-1}K
$$
of the composite
$$
f'^{-1}g^{-1}Rf_*K\xrightarrow{\theta^D_{\square,\Lambda,Rf_*K}}g'^{-1}f^{-1}Rf_*K\xrightarrow{g'^{-1}\varepsilon_{f,K}}g'^{-1}K.
$$
Equivalently it is the composite
$$
g^{-1}Rf_*K\xrightarrow{\eta_{f',g^{-1}Rf_*K}}Rf'_*f'^{-1}g^{-1}Rf_*K\xrightarrow{Rf'_*\theta^D_{\square,\Lambda,Rf_*K}}Rf'_*g'^{-1}f^{-1}Rf_*K\xrightarrow{Rf'_*g'^{-1}\varepsilon_{f,K}}Rf'_*g'^{-1}K.
$$
This uses the same mate formula as [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange], now on unbounded module derived categories. No isomorphism assertion is included.

This equivalent interface descends exact inverse image termwise and takes its canonical derived adjunction mate, with the same square comparison and K-injective-derived direct image. It states the full unbounded exchange notion for module and abelian coefficients without tensor hypotheses.
